### Short answer
To compare our Oscilloscope solution with a competitor for Automotive, the evidence must directly connect **our oscilloscope solution**, the **competitor solution**, and the **Automotive use case**; separate passages that mention scopes, competitors, or automotive individually are insufficient for a supported comparison [100].
### Required evidence
| Evidence needed | Why it is required |
|---|---|
| A cited source that directly compares our Oscilloscope solution with the named competitor in an Automotive context | A comparison or recommendation needs a cited passage directly connecting the relevant facets; separate co-mentions are insufficient [100]. |
| Formal R&S oscilloscope specifications / features documents for any claim about our product capability | Competitor-comparison pages cannot replace formal R&S specifications / features documents when making technical claims [3]. |
| Competitor official documentation or third-party evidence for any claim about the competitor | R&S internal battle-card claims about competitors should be verified with competitor official data and third-party evidence before use in customer documents [3], and the same limitation is stated for Keysight comparisons [53]. |
| Avoidance of sales-language claims unless backed by formal evidence | Phrases such as “only platform,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” or “fewer boxes” are sales language and should not be treated as verifiable technical specifications [3][53]. |

The provided passages do not contain a supported comparison of an **Oscilloscope solution** against a **competitor** specifically for **Automotive**; the only oscilloscope-related passages mention scopes as instrument types for interface or power-distribution testing, without tying them to Automotive or a competitor comparison [25][26].-offsetof

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張 › 來源主張
- 來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully validated high-throughput performance of a [[5G NR]] connection at **13 GHz**。
- 來源明示 proposed [[FR3]] frequency range 為 **7.125 GHz to 24.25 GHz**。
- 來源說 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 的 5G mobile test platform（MTP）使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] in a maximum throughput use case at 13 GHz。
- 來源稱該 achievement confirms the potential of [[FR3]] to deliver high data rates using high [[MCS]]，並透過 [[4x4 MIMO]] enhanced capacity。
- 來源未提到 [[RFU18]]，也未提供 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 13 GHz hardware / software configuration。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]]（來源未標示 published date；raw created 2026-09-11；demo 日期 March 2 to 5, 2026）：

- 來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully demonstrated carrier aggregation across [[FR1]] and [[FR3]] frequency ranges。
- Demo 聚合約 **2.5 GHz** [[FR1]] channel 與約 **7 GHz** [[FR3]] channel，兩 band 均使用 [[4x4 MIMO]] 與 higher-order modulation。
- Test setup 核心是 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester，extended with new [[RFU18]] board to provide coverage up to **18 GHz**。
- 來源稱 [[RFU18]] is a modular hardware upgrade for the [[R&S CMX500]] platform，讓 existing testers extend towards [[6G]]。
- 來源稱 all existing [[R&S CMX500]] platforms can be enhanced with new [[RFU18]] board to extend frequency coverage and capabilities without replacing the entire system。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] engineered for data rates up to **20 Gbps**，supporting wide dynamic range、[[4096QAM]] 與 up to **16 device antenna ports**。
- 來源仍未提供 [[RFU18]] order number、formal specs 文件編號、bandwidth、throughput、MCS index、software release 或 measurement conditions。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

Hybrid eCall testing
[[Hybrid eCall testing]] 是驗證車輛 emergency call system 能在 NG eCall 與 classic CS eCall transport paths 之間可靠運作與 fallback 的測試主題；[[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 將其連到 [[EN 18052]]:2025、[[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026、[[R&S CMX500]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KA09x]]。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 FR1 bandwidth beyond 400 MHz，例如 600–800 MHz per carrier for 5G-Advanced Rel-18 / Rel-19 testing？
2. 是否需要 FR1、FR2、FR3、WLAN 與 LTE 在 single instrument 中且不用 hardware swaps？
3. 是否需要 native fading with high-throughput IP testing？
4. 是否偏好 one unified software platform，而不是 four separate tools？
5. 是否需要 advanced CA 或 mobility without adding extra boxes？
6. 是否需要 FR3 testing beyond 16 GHz，以支援 emerging 6G FR3 evaluations？

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + Fading + IP**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 unified system，對比 Anritsu 的 MT8000A、MT8862A、IP Option 012 + external PC、external fading chambers 與 separate RF boards。
- **FR2 / FR3 performance leadership**：主張 R&S up to 50 GHz FR2、>16 GHz instantaneous bandwidth、>10 Gbps data rates 與 FR3 via RFU18；使用時需加註非正式規格限制。
- **Integrated WLAN signaling**：主張 R&S Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling directly inside CMX500，Anritsu 需 separate MT8862A。

SMA100B_specs_en_5215-1018-22_v1000 › 重點摘要
- 來源為 Rohde & Schwarz R&S®SMA100B RF and Microwave Signal Generator 規格書，文件代碼 PD 5215.1018.22，Specifications Version 10.00，日期 February 2026；PDF 來源檔為 SMA100B_specs_en_5215-1018-22_v1000.pdf。
- [[R&S SMA100B]] 是 RF and Microwave Signal Generator，base unit Order No. 1419.8888.02；訂購時必須搭配一個 R&S®SMAB-B1xx frequency option，以及 R&S®SMAB-B92 或 R&S®SMAB-B93 platform height option。
- Frequency options 覆蓋 8 kHz to 3 GHz、6 GHz、12.75 GHz、20 GHz、31.8 GHz、40 GHz、50 GHz、67 GHz；67 GHz 型號有 overrange 67 GHz to 72 GHz。
- Product data 適用條件：在 ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘，符合指定 environmental conditions，遵守 recommended calibration interval，並執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。
- Key phase-noise claims：base unit 在 10 GHz、20 kHz offset 的 SSB phase noise 為 < –120 dBc typ.；搭配 R&S®SMAB-B711 option 時，在 10 GHz、10 kHz offset 為 < –132 dBc typ.；close-in SSB phase noise 在 f = 10 GHz、offset = 10 Hz 時為 < –83 dBc typ.；wideband noise 在 10 GHz、30 MHz offset 時為 < –162 dBc typ.。
- Output power key claims：6 GHz model 搭配 ultra high output power 可達 38 dBm；20 GHz model 在 18 GHz 超過 30 dBm、20 GHz 為 28 dBm；40 GHz model 在 20 GHz to 35 GHz 超過 30 dBm；67 GHz model 到 70 GHz 仍超過 20 dBm。
- 機箱高度可為 2 HU（R&S®SMAB-B92，5-inch touch display）或 3 HU（R&S®SMAB-B93，7-inch touch display）；high output power 在高頻 options 上多數需要 3 HU。
- Analog modulation、pulse modulation、chirped pulses、VOR/ILS、pulse train、power analysis、differential clock synthesizer、HUMS、remote control GPIB/USB 等功能由 R&S®SMAB-Kxxx 或 R&S®SMAB-Bxxx options 提供。
- Level、setting range 與 output power 規格依 frequency option、power option 與 serial number 分段；特別是 R&S®SMAB-B150/-B150N/-B167/-B167N 在 serial number < 120000 與 ≥ 120000 有不同 specified level range。

### Short answer
To compare our Oscilloscope solution with a competitor for Automotive, the evidence must directly connect **our oscilloscope solution**, the **competitor solution**, and the **Automotive use case**; separate passages that mention scopes, competitors, or automotive individually are insufficient for a supported comparison [100].
### Required evidence
| Evidence needed | Why it is required |
|---|---|
| A cited source that directly compares our Oscilloscope solution with the named competitor in an Automotive context | A comparison or recommendation needs a cited passage directly connecting the relevant facets; separate co-mentions are insufficient [100]. |
| Formal R&S oscilloscope specifications / features documents for any claim about our product capability | Competitor-comparison pages cannot replace formal R&S specifications / features documents when making technical claims [3]. |
| Competitor official documentation or third-party evidence for any claim about the competitor | R&S internal battle-card claims about competitors should be verified with competitor official data and third-party evidence before use in customer documents [3], and the same limitation is stated for Keysight comparisons [53]. |
| Avoidance of sales-language claims unless backed by formal evidence | Phrases such as “only platform,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” or “fewer boxes” are sales language and should not be treated as verifiable technical specifications [3][53]. |
### What the current passages do not support
The provided passages do not contain a supported comparison of an **Oscilloscope solution** against a **competitor** specifically for **Automotive**; the only oscilloscope-related passages mention scopes as instrument types for interface or power-distribution testing, without tying them to Automotive or a competitor comparison [25][26].-offsetof
